messages.subject: picknplot.shape Error
parts:
Hello, 

I have been struggling to use picknplot.shape successfully, even with the example code in the help page of picknplot.shape. I have tried using both the example code's datasets and my own. 

Y.gpa <- gpagen(plethodon$land)
pleth.pca <- gm.prcomp(Y.gpa$coords)
pleth.pca.plot <- plot(pleth.pca)
picknplot.shape(pleth.pca.plot)
# May change arguments for plotRefToTarget
picknplot.shape(plot(pleth.pca), method = "points", mag = 3,
links=plethodon$links)

Here is the error message: Error in do.call(plot, x$plot.args) : second argument must be a list

Any help would be greatly appreciated! 

Best, 

Ricardo Ely

Dear Ricardo,

Updating packages to most current versions will probably solve this issue.  You are using an older version of geomorph and this issue has been fixed already.  The code worked fine for me.

Mike
